Dana (Finance): CloudServe invoice CSV-9001 arrived referencing PO 9001-BUT that PO belongs to a different vendor. Amount $3,420. No approver in the routing table, payment blocked.

ProcureBot: Auto-validate: PO_VENDOR_MISMATCH for invoice CSV-9001. Suggested action: vendor to reissue or AP to attach to correct PO.

Ravi (AP): Can someone confirm the correct PO? I see PO 9001 exists but vendor is EdgeOps.

CloudServe Billing: Hi Redwood — apologies. We accidentally applied partner PO 9001-B to your invoice during a batch. We also applied customer credit CR-331 on 2026-10-30 (TXN ID REF-331). We can reissue without the partner PO or reference your PO 9144 if you supply it. Contact billing@cloudserve.com

Marta (Procurement): CloudServe is approved and PO 9144 exists for "cloud inference credits" under cost center infra-services. That PO has $5k remaining.

Ravi (AP): Trying manual attach to PO 9144 but system rejects: "approver group missing for cost center infra-services". Can procurement add approver?

Marta (Procurement): I'll add approver group infra-ops now.

ProcureBot: Cost center mapping updated: infra-services -> infra-ops.

Ravi (AP): Updated invoice cost center to infra-services and attached PO 9144. Routing to infra-ops for approval. Status: Pending approval. Payment held until credit REF-331 reconciled. Ticket FIN-9710 opened.

CloudServe Billing: We'll send corrected invoice referencing PO 9144 and include proof of credit REF-331 in the email.

Dana (Finance): Thanks all — hold payment until AP confirms credit posted. :hourglass:
